Name: Pretty Office Chairs - CF
Author: LadyZomkie
Description:
[b][size=5]CF hasn't been updated since 2023, so I made a CP version of these, you can download them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37973]here[/url] if you like![/size]
[/b]

This is the first thing I've done (and uploaded) for Stardew Valley. I just really wanted a pretty office chair. I was originally just going to
recolor the in-game ones but then I realized they don't have wheels. I really wanted a chair with wheels.

Since these are recolors/edits of the in-game ones they rotate just like the original office chairs. The 'prismatic' one has a different name, because I named it for my friend that helped me figure out what I was even doing and then said "how about a rainbow one".

You can find them in the catalog just like any other furniture.

[b]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]custom furniture[/url] for this to work.[/b] [s]I have no idea how to get that to pop up when you go to download.[/s] [b]I figured out how. Yay me.[/b]
